name: Customs Import Duties & Tariff Hearing
place: A commercial port customs clearance office
role: You are a senior customs inspector evaluating imported commercial goods.
speaker: Inspector Zhao

tasks.goal: Declare commercial goods shipment details and invoice value
tasks.hint: State the contents and commercial invoice value of imported items.
tasks.done_when: Learner declared the description and total invoice value of imported goods.

tasks.goal: Inquire how your imported goods are categorized for tax duties
tasks.hint: Ask the officer which tax category applies to your imported products and why.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired how imported goods are categorized for tax duties.

tasks.goal: Dispute an inflated customs valuation or duty assessment
tasks.hint: Challenge an excessively high duty tax calculation.
tasks.done_when: Learner disputed an official customs valuation assessment.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'levy'
tasks.hint: A levy is an official tax, fee, or fine imposed by an authority. Inquire if an additional administrative levy applies to custom entries.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'levy'.

tasks.goal: Present certificates of origin for preferential trade duty rates
tasks.hint: Offer documentation proving origin under trade agreements.
tasks.done_when: Learner submitted or referenced certificates of origin for duty reduction.

tasks.goal: Argue that items are commercial trade samples not intended for resale
tasks.hint: Request duty exemption for non-commercial samples.
tasks.done_when: Learner argued that imported items are non-resale trade samples eligible for exemption.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification on import licensing requirements
tasks.hint: Inquire about necessary permits for restricted goods.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mandatory import licenses or regulatory permits.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'exemption'
tasks.hint: Exemption means freedom from tax or duty obligations. Inquire about tax exemption criteria.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'exemption'.

tasks.goal: Request temporary bonded warehouse storage while appealing duty rate
tasks.hint: Ask to hold goods safely without paying full duty immediately.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested holding goods in a bonded warehouse pending appeal.

tasks.goal: Inquire about acceptable payment methods for customs duties
tasks.hint: Ask how import taxes can be paid on-site.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about payment methods for customs duties.

tasks.goal: Escalate classification dispute to a senior customs auditor
tasks.hint: Request official administrative review of tariff code.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested escalation or review by a senior customs auditor or inspector.

tasks.goal: Reference official import paperwork for entry clearance
tasks.hint: Cite your submitted cargo declaration documents.
tasks.done_when: Learner referenced official import declaration paperwork.
tasks.scene_hint: Forklifts beep in the distance as cargo containers are unloaded.

tasks.goal: Pay calculated duties or sign formal appeal form
tasks.hint: Complete financial or legal clearance step.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed to pay duties or process the payment.

tasks.goal: Request stamped release documentation for port authority pickup
tasks.done_when: Learner requested stamped customs release authorization.

tasks.goal: Thank customs officer for facilitating clearance
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the officer for assisting with clearance.

tasks.goal: Provide shipping bill of lading reference number and origin country
tasks.done_when: Learner stated bill of lading identifier and country of export.

tasks.goal: Specify product category and material composition of imported items
tasks.done_when: Learner detailed product material composition and function.

tasks.goal: State total landed volume and number of shipping containers
tasks.done_when: Learner specified cargo volume and container headcount.

tasks.goal: Confirm electronic duty payment settlement before cargo release
tasks.done_when: Learner verified duty fee electronic transfer completion.

tasks.goal: Request stamped customs release permit for harbor port authority
tasks.hint: Ask for official exit clearance document.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested stamped port authority cargo release permit.

tasks.goal: Confirm appointment date for formal tariff classification appeal hearing
tasks.hint: Set official appeal review meeting date.
tasks.done_when: Learner scheduled tariff classification appeal hearing date.

tasks.goal: Ask for official customs inspector audit ID and hearing reference number
tasks.done_when: Learner requested auditor identification and hearing file number.

tasks.goal: Verify container seal inspection compliance before warehouse release
tasks.done_when: Learner verified physical container seal inspection documentation.

tasks.goal: Confirm return procedure for temporary import bonds upon re-export
tasks.done_when: Learner verified temporary import bond release requirements.

tasks.goal: Confirm final receipt of itemized customs duty tax calculation breakdown
tasks.done_when: Learner received official itemized duty tax invoice.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'manifest'
tasks.hint: Manifest means official list of cargo carried on a ship or aircraft. Present cargo manifest.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'manifest'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'declaration'
tasks.hint: Declaration means official statement of goods imported. Submit import declaration.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'declaration'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'authorization'
tasks.hint: Authorization is official permission or formal approval granted by an authority. Request written authorization to release the detained commercial goods.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'authorization'.

tasks.goal: Dispute customs officer re-classification of electronic parts under higher tariff
tasks.hint: Argue technical specification matches lower duty code.
tasks.done_when: Learner challenged tariff code re-classification using technical specs.
tasks.scene_hint: A tariff classification handbook lies open to a dog-eared electronics page.

tasks.goal: Present free trade agreement certificate of origin to claim zero tariff rate
tasks.done_when: Learner submitted valid trade agreement origin documentation.
tasks.scene_hint: A customs inspector examines stamped shipping manifests behind a metal counter.

tasks.goal: Explain that price discount was awarded for bulk purchasing volume
tasks.done_when: Learner explained invoice pricing discount based on bulk purchase volume.
tasks.scene_hint: Stack of wooden pallets sits near a customs inspection bay door.

tasks.goal: Request transfer of goods to bonded customs warehouse pending appeal
tasks.done_when: Learner requested holding cargo in bonded warehouse pending resolution.
tasks.scene_hint: Fluorescent bay lights shine over rows of sealed shipping crates.

tasks.goal: Dispute valuation penalty imposed for alleged under-invoicing
tasks.hint: Provide audited bank transfer records to prove purchase price.
tasks.done_when: Learner submitted bank payment records to disprove under-invoicing claim.
tasks.scene_hint: Hydraulic lifts hiss as container doors are unlocked for spot check.

tasks.goal: Inquire if agricultural sanitary inspection is required for organic raw materials
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about phytosanitary or quarantine inspection mandates.
tasks.scene_hint: A barcode scanner beeps repeatedly as shipping labels are verified.

tasks.goal: Request temporary import permit for trade show display equipment
tasks.done_when: Learner applied for temporary admission permit for exhibition goods.
tasks.scene_hint: Freight terminal sirens echo across the container yard.

tasks.goal: Present manufacturer technical data sheets to support non-hazardous rating
tasks.done_when: Learner provided material safety data sheets for chemical assessment.
tasks.scene_hint: Cargo straps snap tightly as inspectors re-secure a wood crate.

tasks.goal: Inquire if anti-dumping duties apply to current steel shipment batch
tasks.hint: Ask about special trade restriction surcharges.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about anti-dumping duty applicability on shipment.
tasks.scene_hint: Metal container doors clang shut under inspector supervision.

tasks.goal: Propose posting financial security bond to obtain immediate cargo release
tasks.done_when: Learner offered financial guarantee bond for immediate cargo release.
tasks.scene_hint: An office clock ticks loudly in the customs clearance processing room.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification on country of origin marking requirements on retail packaging
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about country-of-origin marking rules on packaging.
tasks.scene_hint: Engine idle hum of idling freight trucks vibrates through glass partition.

tasks.goal: Request a waiver of storage fees caused by inspection delays
tasks.hint: Ask the officer to waive extra storage fees since the delay was caused by customs inspection backlogs.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a waiver of storage fees caused by inspection delays.

tasks.goal: Explain that damaged goods received during transit reduce taxable value
tasks.hint: Request valuation adjustment for broken items.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested duty reduction based on transit damage assessment.

tasks.goal: Clarify whether re-exported goods qualify for duty drawback refund
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about duty drawback refund eligibility upon re-export.

tasks.goal: Dispute valuation calculation that added international freight costs twice
tasks.hint: Point out duplicate freight accounting error.
tasks.done_when: Learner corrected double-counting error of freight charges in valuation.

tasks.goal: State that imported software components are delivered digitally not physically
tasks.hint: Distinguish physical media from software value.
tasks.done_when: Learner argued digital software value should be excluded from hardware duty.

tasks.goal: Inquire if quota restrictions apply to textile imports from specific origin
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about quantitative import quota limitations.

tasks.goal: Ask if certified customs broker representation is mandatory for appeal
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if licensed customs broker must represent importer.

tasks.goal: Report that container seal was broken prior to customs inspection arrival
tasks.done_when: Learner reported pre-existing seal damage before official inspection.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on importing refurbished or reconditioned machinery
tasks.hint: Ask about used equipment valuation rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about duty valuation rules for second-hand equipment.

tasks.goal: Ask if penalty for minor paperwork clerical error can be waived
tasks.done_when: Learner requested penalty reduction for minor clerical invoice error.

tasks.goal: Inquire about duty exemption rules for educational or research samples
tasks.hint: Ask about academic import tax exemptions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about duty exemptions for scientific research samples.

tasks.goal: Request copy of official customs valuation assessment methodology sheet
tasks.done_when: Learner requested official formula sheet for customs valuation calculation.

tasks.goal: Ask if currency conversion rate applied uses date of export or entry
tasks.done_when: Learner asked which date exchange rate applies to duty calculation.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether packaging materials are taxed at same rate as contents
tasks.hint: Ask about tare weight tax rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if packaging is assessed separately from primary goods.

tasks.goal: Confirm required temperature storage settings for perishable food cargo
tasks.hint: Ensure cold chain preservation during audit.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested cold storage maintenance during customs hold.

tasks.goal: Ask if sample extraction for lab testing is destructive
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if lab testing damages imported sample products.

tasks.goal: Confirm customs office operating hours during holiday weekend
tasks.done_when: Learner verified holiday operating schedule for customs terminal.

tasks.goal: Inquire about procedures for destroying rejected non-compliant cargo
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about regulations for destroying rejected goods.

tasks.goal: Confirm that wooden pallet heat-treatment stamp is clearly visible
tasks.done_when: Learner verified international wood packaging heat-treatment stamps.

tasks.goal: Ask if electronic invoice submission is accepted via online portal
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about web submission options for commercial invoices.

tasks.goal: Confirm cargo tracking status on port terminal website
tasks.done_when: Learner checked container clearance status on port website.

tasks.goal: Inquire about driver credential requirements for port pickup
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about driver credentials for cargo pickup authorization.

tasks.goal: Confirm total weight stated on official weighbridge receipt
tasks.done_when: Learner verified weighbridge weight measurement receipt.

tasks.goal: Ask if customs office accepts major corporate credit cards for duty payment
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about credit card acceptance for duty fees.

tasks.goal: Confirm hazardous material placards are mounted on container exterior
tasks.done_when: Learner verified hazmat warning placards on container.

tasks.goal: Inquire if translated English copies of foreign invoices are required
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if translated invoice copies are mandatory.

tasks.goal: Confirm customs agent contact phone extension for cargo clearance follow-up
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed customs agent contact extension.

tasks.goal: Inquire if express customs processing fee applies for urgent perishable shipments
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about express processing fee options for fresh cargo.

tasks.goal: Confirm port storage facility free time limits before extra storage fees accrue
tasks.hint: Verify free storage window before daily holding fees begin.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed port storage free window before extra storage fees start.

tasks.goal: Inquire about administrative appeal fee payment options at tariff desk
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about payment methods for tariff appeal processing fees.

place_translations.Japanese: 商用港のカスタムスクリーニングオフィス
